title: The Dragon's Wake
text: A dragon has died in the valley below, and its kind have come to hold a wake. They circle above it and sing, a sound like mountains breaking, a grief so huge it shakes stones loose from the cliffs. The air tastes of smoke and tears.

options.label: Mourn with them, at a distance.

outcomes.text: A great dragon notices you mourning, and bows its head to you, once.

options.label: The quietest steals a fallen scale.

outcomes.text: A dragon's scale, still warm, unseen.

options.label: The wisest listens to the song.

outcomes.text: The song is a history, older than the Houses, and it names the End Ruler.
